title: LA Colossal – Gamji-geumni 02 (Standing)

No plain indigo areas, no religious figures. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Background & Lighting: Joseon royal library with indigo-and-gold manuscripts and paper windows, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lamp key with raking side light. ONE woman only.
